notes: identity is a T0 substrate µservice. All tenant_class-1 OSes are mandatory CI lanes. Per ADR-0244 every OS lane exercises both tenant_class fixtures (demo_trial + paid). Per ADR-0329 the per-OS package matrix preserves ADR-0248 cellular criticality vocabulary (tenant_class 0..tenant_class 4) but does NOT carry retired capability-adoption vocabulary (demo_trial/paid with per_seat billing_component/paid with per_usage billing_component/paid with compliance_pack gating).

tier_1.name: Talos Linux
tier_1.primary_use: Kubernetes-only cell baseline; minimal API-only OS for cell nodes hosting Zitadel + identity-api workloads

tier_1.name: Red Hat Enterprise Linux
tier_1.primary_use: Enterprise on-prem; healthcare IDN preference; BAA-eligible identity substrate; FIPS 140-3 L2 OpenBao co-deploy

tier_1.name: Oracle Linux
tier_1.primary_use: OCI-guest deploy default; OCI Always Free demo_trial substrate (Ampere A1 4 OCPU + 24 GiB)

tier_1.name: SUSE Linux Enterprise Server
tier_1.primary_use: Enterprise EU + APAC on-prem; sovereign-cell hosts for EU GDPR Art.9 sensitive-data IDP deployments

tier_1.name: Ubuntu
tier_1.primary_use: Public-cloud SaaS baseline for Zitadel + OIDC issuer; dev + CI default

tier_1.name: Debian
tier_1.primary_use: On-prem + colo edge identity nodes; smaller attack surface than Ubuntu

tier_1.name: Rocky Linux
tier_1.primary_use: RHEL-binary-compatible on-prem alternative for tenants without Red Hat support contracts

tier_1.name: AlmaLinux
tier_1.primary_use: RHEL-binary-compatible alternative used by EU public-sector tenants under sovereign-pack preferences

tier_1.name: CentOS Stream
tier_1.primary_use: Upstream RHEL test lane; community on-prem identity deployments

tier_1.name: Amazon Linux
tier_1.primary_use: AWS-guest default for tenant-owned EKS clusters hosting the identity workload

tier_1.name: Flatcar Container Linux
tier_1.primary_use: Container-optimized auto-updating CoreOS successor; preferred for high-replica OIDC issuer cells

tier_1.name: Photon OS (VMware)
tier_1.primary_use: VMware vSphere-hosted on-prem cells; healthcare IDNs and enterprise customers with vSphere standardization

tier_1.name: macOS
tier_1.primary_use: Developer workstation only — NOT a runtime target for the identity µservice. Used to build, test, and run the dev CLI (`oya identity ...`).

tier_2.rationale: IBM Power servers in regulated healthcare IDNs running legacy AIX-migrated workloads on Linux; test-only lane.
IBM Z mainframes in major EU and US financial-grade data centers; test-only lane.

explicitly_unsupported.rationale: identity is Linux-native; Windows runtime adds attack surface plus licensing complexity. Tenants needing Windows-domain SSO use the cloud-iam ADFS bridge feeding identity over OIDC.
Apple deprecated Intel macOS support 2024-2026 cycle; tenant_class-1 dev workstation is Apple Silicon M5+ only per memory feedback_os_support_matrix_2026_05_20.
Performance and Secure Enclave baseline assumes M5-generation; pre-M5 macOS is not a supported dev target.
Not in tenant_class-1 hyperscaler standard set; would dilute supported-OS focus.
Not in tenant_class-1 hyperscaler standard set.
End-of-life vendor ecosystem; not compatible with the OpenBao + Cilium + Zitadel substrate.

release_artifacts_per_os: container-image (multi-arch OCI; signed via cosign + Rekor per ADR-0039)
rpm-package (rhel, oracle-linux, suse, rocky, almalinux, centos-stream, amazon-linux, photon)

tenant_class_lane_coverage.demo_trial: Every tenant_class-1 OS CI lane runs the demo_trial fixture per ADR-0331 §D-11
tenant_class_lane_coverage.paid: Every tenant_class-1 OS CI lane runs the paid fixture per ADR-0331 §D-11
